Аліса Вайдель виступила за заміну Bürgergeld на їжу, житло та мило . Вона вважає, що такі зміни змусять 90% отримувачів допомоги добровільно залишити країну. Український Телеграм

❗️ Українські біженці ризикують лишитися без виплат в Німеччині — лідерка німецької «Альтернатива для Німеччини» Аліса Вайдель зробила ряд антиукраїнських заяв. Цитуємо: «Як тільки ми запропонуємо лише їжу, житло та мило замість цих надмірних виплат «Bürgergeld», понад 90% тих, хто отримує ці виплати, добровільно поїдуть. І ми це реалізуємо. Вона додала, що Німеччина не може й надалі перерозподіляти кошти на користь України. Серед усього і припинення постачання зброї. Співголова «АдН» Тіно Хрупалла також заявив, що з 2015 року в Німеччину прибули 1,2 мільйона українців . Як тільки закінчиться війна — вони мають покинути Німеччину. 🇺🇦 Реальна Війна | Підписатись

🌊 At least 30 rivers in the South American country have overflowed, and another 12 are showing signs of rising water levels, following heavy rainfall linked to the El Niño phenomenon, according to the National Secretariat for Risk Management (SNGRE). Since August 29, the rains have left at least 27 people dead and 13 injured. During that period, 1,883 adverse events—including floods, landslides, heavy rains, windstorms, and water erosion—were recorded, affecting all 24 provinces in the country. 📊 The impact affected a total of 110,855 people, including those directly affected and those indirectly impacted. The Secretariat continues to monitor the river basins as rainfall persists. 🌎 The El Niño phenomenon is intensifying the rainy season in the Andean region and keeping risk management systems across Latin America on high alert.

Visioner BIG | 🇩🇪 🇺🇦 🇷🇺 ‼️ ‼️ German Chancellor Friedrich Merz says NATO made a historic mistake in 2008 by failing to follow the American proposal on Ukraine’s membership, arguing that Russia’s war against Ukraine could have been prevented. Referring to the 2008 NATO summit in Bucharest, Merz said that, looking back, the decision not to move forward with Ukraine’s admission to the alliance was a major error. He believes that Ukraine’s membership at the time would likely have deterred Russia from launching its invasion. Merz’s remarks revive a central debate over European security and NATO’s past decisions. Although the alliance declared in 2008 that Ukraine would eventually become a member, it offered no membership timetable or immediate security guarantees. His assessment highlights the argument that stronger Western security commitments might have changed Moscow’s calculations before the war. See the latest updates with us: @visionergeo tweet

Visioner BIG | 🇪🇺 🇺🇸 🇷🇺 ‼️ ‼️ NATO Secretary General Mark Rutte has called on alliance members to prepare their citizens, businesses, and government institutions for the possibility of war amid growing concerns over the threat posed by Russia. Rutte stressed the need for broader civilian and institutional preparedness across NATO countries. His warning goes beyond military readiness, highlighting the importance of ensuring that governments, businesses, and the wider population can respond effectively to a potential conflict. The statement reflects NATO’s growing focus on preparing entire societies for security threats, not just strengthening armed forces. Civilian resilience, critical infrastructure protection, and emergency planning are increasingly important parts of European defense. Rutte’s warning does not mean war is inevitable, but it underscores the seriousness with which the alliance views the Russian threat. See the latest updates with us: @visionergeo tweet
